what: Swiping an unflipped card flips it and then marks it 'Got it' or 'Again' 350 ms later, before the user has seen the answer. The keyboard path only rates after a flip. A mostly vertical mouse drag with 100 px of sideways drift is also rated, because dx is stored before the 'dy > dx' check.
evidence: Desktop: drag the unflipped card 150 px right → FL.got 1, S.flash has 1 entry, and the answer was never shown. Drag (+100, +300) → FL.i 1→2, got 2.
fix: When !FL.flipped, a swipe should only flip, with no rating. Track the dominant axis and ignore pointerup when |dy| > |dx|. Add a pointercancel handler that resets the card.

where: Hand kit: hold menus (MENUS) and hold-to-explain hints
what: Several actions exist only behind a long-press with a pointer: "Mark as done" and "Mark as not done" (lessons), "Reset its review schedule" (mastery tiles), "Copy link" (tools), "Forget my result" (shifts), "Show in the concept web", and "Teach it back" from a lesson. Shift+F10 and the ContextMenu key do nothing (the contextmenu default is prevented). The hint text (data-hint on heat squares, pips, XP, streak) is shown only in a pointer tooltip with role=tooltip, which is not referenced by aria-describedby. Fails WCAG 2.1.1.
evidence: kb3.py: focus .llist button[data-l], press Shift+F10 or ContextMenu -> no sheet. grep shows "Mark as done", "Reset its review", "Forget my result" and "Copy link" exist only in kit.js.
fix: Open the same MENUS sheet from the keyboard: on a "contextmenu" event (which fires for Shift+F10 and the Menu key) whose target matches a MENUS selector, call sheet(...) instead of preventDefault only. Add a visible "⋯" more button (aria-label "More actions for <name>", aria-haspopup="dialog") to lesson rows, mastery tiles and tool tiles. For data-hint items, expose the text with aria-describedby or a visually hidden span, and show the bubble on focus as well as on hold.

what: In Quiet mode, holding the module-check row shows 'Module check / Timed questions from the whole module. 80% wins the badge and 120 XP.' The XP and badge wording remain.
evidence: Learn → open a module → hold .bossrow .note: bubble text captured as above.
fix: Make the hint Quiet-aware: 'Timed questions from the whole module. 80% passes.' Add the badge/XP clause only when S.quiet===false. Do the same for the '.badge-tile' and '#hdr-xp' hints (hidden in Quiet, so lower priority).

what: The heatmap legend says 'Darker = more gases read', but in the dark theme the scale is dark brown (1–5), pale peach (6–14), orange (15+). The middle step is the brightest, so the scale is not monotonic, and 'darker' is the wrong word in dark mode. Per-cell data-hint overrides the legend, so it is almost never reachable anyway. The cells have no on-screen key.
evidence: T23-seed-quiet-desk.png: 31/10 (9 gases) is pale peach and brighter than 18/10 (30 gases, orange). The light theme (T23-tablet-clinical-light.png) is fine.
fix: In dark themes order l1<l2<l3 by luminance (e.g. l2: color-mix(accent 55%, surface)). Add a 4-square key 'less → more' under the grid, and reword the hint to 'Stronger colour = more gases'.
